revision_rule.note: The 2012 blocking_assignment grammar does not include the later inc_or_dec_expression alternative.
The 2017 blocking-assignment grammar omits the increment/decrement-expression alternative that is included in the 2023 grammar.
The 2012 rule prohibits automatic-variable targets but does not prohibit dynamically sized array elements, which remain admitted by variable_lvalue grammar.
IEEE 1800-2017 does not prohibit nonblocking assignment to an element of a dynamically sized array.
The 2012 null-item exception covers class and interface-class elements only; it does not additionally cover event, chandle, or virtual-interface elements.
